evidence.section: 17. Human Review Is an Epistemic Interface
evidence.excerpt: A reproducibility or provenance failure belongs to PPE.
A useful principle is: Source identity belongs to PPE as much as to signal processing.
PPE is best understood as a trust plane running through every Ear layer rather than as a separate application module.

A resource-constrained architecture should separate mandatory sensors from optional expensive models and should cache reusable representations. | Tier | Purpose | Compute policy | | --- | --- | --- | | Tier 0 | Source identity, decode validation, cheap integrity checks | Always run; CPU | | Tier 1 | Core WSE/PPE deterministic measurements | Always run; CPU-first | | Tier 2 | Selected learned representations / heavier structure models | Run only when judgment value justifies cost | | Tier 3 | Research training, large comparison experiments | Offline; not required for product completion | Tier 0/1 analysis can run on CPU and produce deterministic engineering evidence.
PPE runs through the entire system as a trust plane.
This is PPE operating inside the physical layer.

**Technical Monographs - Volume I** **Chapter VII - PPE - Making Hearing Trustworthy** **August 2026** > A hearing result becomes knowledge only when identity, evidence, state and lineage survive the run that produced it.
Production Process Engineering, or PPE, exists to solve this second-order problem.
PPE asks: *How was this hearing produced reliably?* PPE does not make the Ear more sensitive in the immediate perceptual sense.
PPE should not be implemented as one administrative module placed beside the auditory pipeline.

PPE makes those dependencies visible at the unit of the Production Case. | Without PPE | Failure of trust | | --- | --- | | No source hash | Cannot prove which audio was analyzed | | No run identity | Cannot reconstruct which execution produced the result | | Mutable defaults | Same command may mean different things over time | | No evidence index | Judgment cannot be audited | | One success flag | Partial/failed/blocked cases look complete | | Silent feedback mutation | Historical behavior cannot be reproduced | | No migration contract | Old cases silently change meaning |
PPE should therefore refuse to use a mutable path or display name as the sole case identity.

evidence.section: 11. Determinism Is a Contract, Not an Absolute
evidence.excerpt: PPE should therefore distinguish bitwise determinism, tolerance determinism and statistical reproducibility. | Class | Contract | | --- | --- | | bitwise | Identical bytes or serialized values on supported environment | | tolerance | Numeric outputs agree within declared absolute/relative tolerance | | semantic | Judgment class/evidence relation is stable though low-level numerics vary | | statistical | Distributional behavior is reproducible across repeated stochastic runs | A run should declare the reproducibility class of important outputs.
If one sensor is later found defective, PPE can identify which historical judgments depended on it instead of invalidating every case.

When a deliberate change alters a Golden Case, PPE should require an explicit re-baseline decision rather than silently accepting the new output.

evidence.section: 20. Benchmarks Must Be Frozen Enough to Measure Progress

The distinction between feedback and promotion is one of PPE's most important contributions to a learning Ear.

PPE can classify changes as: | Change class | Example | Expected policy | | --- | --- | --- | | non-semantic | refactor/logging/UI layout | no case-meaning change expected | | compatible feature | new optional evidence artifact | old cases remain valid | | semantic minor | threshold/calibration update | new internal version + regression | | schema/model major | representation meaning changes | migration/compatibility review | | breaking | old contract cannot be supported | explicit deprecation + archive reader | The exact numbering scheme can remain project-specific.
PPE should therefore automate provenance collection wherever possible.

PPE can define assurance as a function of consequence: Risk management frameworks such as NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 23894 emphasize that governance should be proportional to context, impact and uncertainty [8,9].
PPE should distinguish reproducibility metadata from sensitive runtime secrets.
PPE succeeds when such violations become visible and classifiable rather than silently accepted.
PPE creates the interface between production and research: The loop is deliberately closed.
PPE can be summarized by twelve principles. **1.
PPE makes those observations durable enough to become knowledge.
Without PPE, each successful analysis is a demonstration.
With PPE, each validated case becomes part of a reproducible lineage from Ear v1 to every later version.
PPE uses the same status to decide whether a finding is allowed to become authoritative.

These are different interventions. | Observed review problem | Likely technical target | | --- | --- | | measurement incorrect | WSE sensor / decode / parameter | | structure incorrect | MSE model / alignment | | needed pattern absent | representation schema / new feature | | representation sufficient, judgment wrong | rule/model/policy | | confidence poor | calibration / uncertainty propagation | | similar cases not found | retrieval view / embedding / index | | evidence incomplete | projection/provenance/PPE | The LearningRecord should therefore identify which layer is believed to need change.
This is where PPE constrains intelligence: semantic authority is limited by evidential completeness.

evidence.section: 13. Evidence Completeness Is Different from Model Confidence
